question: Can an optional plug-in Option-Q superconducting 4-8 GHz qRAM bridge (50 Ohm transmon <-> 3 kOhm NbTiN 31P flip-flop) achieve high-fidelity round-trip SWAP (>=0.96) and >10^3x quantum memory lifetime gain inside the remaining LD400/PT420 cryostat heat budget, and how do S1-Multi heavy-ion species (167Er 1536 nm silicon-photonic telecom link and 121Sb I=7/2 8-level nuclear qudit) perform from first-principles ABCD, 12x12 Lindblad, 3D ZBL-BCA, and 8x8 spin-Hamiltonian physics?

predictions.description: Exact ABCD 5-section Chebyshev & Klopfenstein 50 Ohm <-> 3 kOhm transformer (f0=6 GHz, Q_int=1e5) satisfies passivity |S11|^2+|S21|^2<=1+1e-12, insertion loss IL(6 GHz)<=0.10 dB, and -15 dB bandwidth >= 2.0 GHz (>=5x wider than single lambda/4 section).

Exact 12x12 CPTP Lindblad SWAP simulation (Transmon <-> Bridge <-> 31P Flip-Flop -> Nuclear Register) preserves Tr(rho)=1 (<1e-10) and positivity (>=-1e-10), achieves round-trip SWAP fidelity F_SWAP_rt >= 0.960, and delivers >= 1,000x memory lifetime gain (time to F=0.90 under T2n,DD=1.0 s vs bare Transmon idle).

Option-Q 4-port 4-8 GHz qRAM bridge + 1-fiber 1550 nm cryo feedthrough adds <= 2.0 uW at 20 mK MXC and <= 0.15 W at 4 K, staying strictly within single LD400/PT420 limits alongside the 1,024-cell Exp140 S6.5 module.

167Er in a 1536 nm Si photonic crystal nanobeam (Q=1e5, V=0.5(lambda/n)^3, DW=0.20) achieves effective Purcell factor F_P_eff >= 500 (cavity lifetime <= 30 us), 10 km SMF-28 heralded Barrett-Kok fidelity F_ent >= 0.85 with R_ent > 1.0 Hz, and Cabrillo single-photon rate > 100 Hz at 10 km.

Exact 3D ZBL binary-collision Monte Carlo (N=4,000 ions/species in Si) proves heavy 121Sb at 14-16 keV matches 5 keV 31P implantation depth (within +-3 nm) with strictly smaller lateral straggle sigma_lat(Sb) < sigma_lat(P).

Exact 8x8 I=7/2 121Sb nuclear Hamiltonian resolves all 7 adjacent NMR transitions by >= 20 kHz at f_Q=35 kHz, verifies Knill-Laflamme single-flip detection for the spin-cat encoding, and honestly evaluates whether high-|m_I| spin-cat (|+-7/2>) beats the strain-protected |+-1/2> clock transition under delta_f_Q=500 Hz strain noise (expected honest FAIL on strain immunity due to I_z^2 scaling).

Exports collision-free s9q_hardware_spec.json for CAD v6.0/BOM v6.0, has zero hardcoded host paths, 0 GFM table errors, visually verified 2400x1400 PNG, and >= 8 passing Exp142 tests with zero regression on existing tests.
